# Declaration atlas

The atlas is generated from the checked-in C++ headers by
`tools/generate_library_docs.py`. Every `class`, `struct`, and `enum class`
declaration found below `include/gui_forms/` and `src/` has one page listing
its hierarchy, declaration and definition locations, declared methods, and
where one exists, a reviewed narrative and a verified capture from
`docs/library/manual.json`.

Status labels are honest about provenance. A **hand-reviewed** narrative was
written by a person against the declaration; a **declaration-derived**
narrative was produced by the generator from the signature alone and states
no measured behavior. **Capture pending** means the visual type has not yet
passed the Screen Sharing crop gate.

| Measure | Count |
| --- | --- |
| Types | 817 |
| Visual controls | 78 |
| Visual controls with verified captures | 67 |
| Visual controls with captures pending | 11 |
| Types with hand-reviewed narratives | 479 |
| Types with declaration-derived narratives | 338 |
| Methods with hand-reviewed explanations | 2569 |
| Methods with declaration-derived explanations | 2179 |
| Grouped source migrations pending | 66 |
| Enumerations | 219 |

Regenerate with:

```sh
python3 tools/generate_library_docs.py
```

Check that the committed atlas matches the headers with:

```sh
python3 tools/generate_library_docs.py --check
```
